instruction: Modify VS Code settings to automatically translate all code comments to Spanish when opening any file, without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in translation capabilities. Automatic comment translation would require AI-powered extensions or external services.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code has no built-in automatic translation capabilities for code comments
Appropriate use of 'infeasible' evaluator function for impossible tasks
Clear explanation in metadata correctly states why this task cannot be completed
No verification logic needed since the task fundamentally cannot be accomplished without extensions
